TASK-6.10.title: Implement worker health check
TASK-6.10.notes: Created Django management command celery_health_check.py that verifies: (1) Celery app initialization, (2) Redis broker connectivity with PING, (3) Active worker stats via celery inspect. Returns exit code 0 for healthy, 1 for unhealthy. Added health check to docker-compose.yml worker service with 30s interval, 10s timeout, 3 retries, 10s start_period.
